mapper.select: SELECT IF( EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM teaching_work WHERE work_file=#{file.id} OR work_cover=#{file.id}) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys_file WHERE id != #{file.id} AND file_path=#{file.filePath} AND file_location=#{file.fileLocation}) OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ( SELECT CONCAT_WS(',',course_icon,course_cover,course_map,course_desc) AS links FROM teaching_course UNION ALL SELECT CONCAT_WS(',',unit_cover,course_video,course_case,course_ppt,course_work,course_work_answer,course_plan,unit_intro,media_content) FROM teaching_course_unit UNION ALL SELECT CONCAT_WS(',',work_cover,work_document_url,work_url,work_desc) FROM teaching_additional_work UNION ALL SELECT h.data_content FROM sys_data_log h JOIN teaching_work w ON w.id=h.data_id WHERE h.data_table='teaching_work' UNION ALL SELECT avatar FROM sys_user UNION ALL SELECT config_value FROM sys_config UNION ALL SELECT news_content FROM teaching_news UNION ALL SELECT CONCAT_WS(',',asset_data,md5_ext) FROM teaching_scratch_assets ) resource_links WHERE LOCATE(#{file.filePath}, links)>0 OR LOCATE(#{file.id}, links)>0 ), 1, 0)
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema=DATABASE() AND table_name='teaching_course_media'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM teaching_course_media WHERE LOCATE(#{file.filePath},media_path)>0 OR LOCATE(#{file.id},media_path)>0
